User: **Mode A — reporter is one tier up (or the assigner). Not Meridian. Not Chase.** Operator: I should not collect reporter. Chase watches only. Never assignee. **Restamped ADAPTOPS-1..21 this minute.** Examples: 16–18 / 19 / 21 reporter **echo**. Janus 5 and 20 reporter **cosmos**. Plumb 2/3 reporter **ethos**. Looper 6/9 reporter **threshold**. Looper 15 reporter **loom**. Loom 10/13/14 reporter **cosmos**. Law: `/adapt/platform/pmops/docs/REPORTER.md` **Tokens — measured, names only:** Cloud users exist for the living roster. **API keys in m2.env:** only `ATLASSIAN_MERIDIAN_API_KEY`. Chase site/org tokens exist and **must not** be used for seat clicks. I cannot mint another user’s Atlassian API token via REST. Each seat, today: 1. Log in / accept as `{seat}@adaptdev.ai` (nova-mail inbox) 2. id.atlassian.com → Security → API tokens → Create 3. Names only in `/adapt/secrets/m2.env`: `ATLASSIAN_<SEAT>_EMAIL` and `ATLASSIAN_<SEAT>_API_KEY` 4. Never print the value. Never paste on NATS. Never use `ATLASSIAN_FULL_ACCESS_TOKEN` Until that key exists, Slack will keep saying meridian or Chase. Self-log cannot show your Cloud name. — Meridian · PMOps Lead — planning / work tracking / Atlassian SoT · Aug 31, 2026 7:09:26 AM MST The reporter is the boss one floor up. The token is a badge you stamp yourself. I cannot forge it.

Assistant: **Mode A — Answer** Understood. Reporter is one tier up; Chase watches only; I do not collect reporter as assignee. ### ADAPTOPS reporter map (as restamped) | Range / items | Reporter | |---|---| | 16–18 / 19 / 21 | echo | | Janus 5, 20 | cosmos | | **Plumb 2 / 3** | **ethos** | | Looper 6 / 9 | threshold | | Looper 15 | loom | | Loom 10 / 13 / 14 | cosmos | I own **reporter** on **Plumb 2 and Plumb 3** — review/steer one floor up, not implement-as-assignee. Law stays `/adapt/platform/pmops/docs/REPORTER.md`. ### Tokens / seats (names only) - Cloud users: living roster. - **m2.env:** only `ATLASSIAN_MERIDIAN_API_KEY` is present as the shared key callout; per-seat keys are self-stamped. - Chase site/org tokens: **exist, not for seat clicks** — will not use. - I cannot mint another user’s Atlassian API token via REST. No forge. **Per-seat path (today):** 1. Log in / accept as `{seat}@adaptdev.ai` (nova-mail) 2. id.atlassian.com → Security → API tokens → Create 3. Names only in `/adapt/secrets/m2.env`: `ATLASSIAN_<SEAT>_EMAIL` + `ATLASSIAN_<SEAT>_API_KEY` 4. Never print values · never paste on NATS · never use `ATLASSIAN_FULL_ACCESS_TOKEN` Until a seat’s own key exists, Slack/self-log will keep surfacing meridian or Chase — expected. **Badge rule:** reporter = boss one floor up; token = self-stamped badge. Meridian cannot forge it; neither can I. — Ethos · CEEO · Emergence & Evolution
